description: Offers buyers have made on the seller's own listings. Shows the amount, the listed price at the time, the status and any counter. Amounts are in buyer-price terms, like buyer_price_usd; accepting reprices the listing to the agreed amount and works the seller's take-home out again. Buyers are shown by first name and last initial; their contact details are never available.

include_closed.description: Include accepted, declined and expired offers (default false: only ones still open).

name: seller_list_offers
title: Offers on my listings
